family_reports.body: This system took precious time from my daughter and me that we can never get back. No family deserves this hell, and no parent should have to fight to prove their love when the evidence already speaks for itself.
They have helped a father punish a family for saying no to ongoing abuse they have stolen our lives, our memories and childhood dreams
family_reports.county: Bexar County, Wichita County, Harris County Texas and Latimer and Haskell County Oklahoma

public_comments.comment_text: Despite hearing testimony from the reporting party acknowledging that I was a fit and loving mother who posed no danger to my child, the court declined to immediately reunify my family or dismiss the case. The court also failed to adequately consider evidence supporting my claims that the allegations were false and retaliatory in nature. Participated in actions that obstructed a fair and impartial review of the case by disregarding exculpatory evidence and testimony supporting my fitness as a parent. Despite testimony that I posed no danger to my child and evidence that the allegations were false or retaliatory, the court declined to order immediate reunification. The judge also engaged in unprofessional courtroom conduct, including mocking my daughter’s name and dismissing my requests for an opportunity to complete services and reunify with my child
